{"predictors": [
{"name": "R&D Intensity Volatility", "construction": "standard deviation of R&D expense divided by sales over the past 5 years", "rationale": "Firms with volatile R&D investments may have more uncertain future cash flows, leading to higher required returns. This volatility can capture the risk associated with innovative activities.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Capital Expenditure Acceleration", "construction": "change in capital expenditures divided by total assets over the past year, minus the same ratio over the previous year", "rationale": "Firms that rapidly increase their capital expenditures may be taking on more risk and investing in potentially high-return projects. This acceleration can signal a shift in the firm's growth strategy.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Inventory Turnover Stability", "construction": "average inventory turnover ratio over the past 5 years, divided by the standard deviation of inventory turnover over the same period", "rationale": "Firms with stable inventory turnover ratios may have more predictable cash flows and lower operational risk. This stability can be attractive to investors seeking lower-risk investments.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Employee Growth Rate", "construction": "average annual growth rate of total employees over the past 3 years", "rationale": "Firms with high employee growth rates may be expanding their operations and investing in human capital, potentially leading to higher future returns. This growth can signal a firm's ability to attract and retain talent.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Supply Chain Efficiency", "construction": "accounts payable divided by cost of goods sold, averaged over the past 2 years", "rationale": "Firms with efficient supply chains may have lower operational costs and higher profitability. This efficiency can be an indicator of a firm's ability to manage its working capital.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Environmental Liability Exposure", "construction": "total environmental liabilities divided by total assets, as reported in the firm's annual financial statements", "rationale": "Firms with high environmental liability exposure may face significant future costs and reputational risks, potentially leading to lower returns. This exposure can capture the risk associated with environmental degradation.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Board Composition Diversity", "construction": "percentage of independent directors on the board, multiplied by the percentage of female directors", "rationale": "Firms with diverse boards may have more effective governance and decision-making processes, potentially leading to higher future returns. This diversity can signal a firm's commitment to inclusivity and social responsibility.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Customer Concentration Risk", "construction": "percentage of total revenue generated by the firm's top 5 customers, averaged over the past 2 years", "rationale": "Firms with high customer concentration risk may face significant revenue volatility and reputational risks, potentially leading to lower returns. This risk can capture the dependence on a few large customers.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Institutional Investor Sentiment Dispersion", "construction": "standard deviation of institutional investor holdings as a percentage of total shares outstanding, over the past quarter", "rationale": "Firms with high dispersion in institutional investor sentiment may have more uncertain future cash flows and higher required returns. This dispersion can capture the risk associated with divergent opinions among sophisticated investors.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Product Market Competition", "construction": "Herfindahl-Hirschman Index of industry concentration, calculated using the firm's industry classification and sales data", "rationale": "Firms operating in highly competitive industries may face significant pricing pressure and lower profitability, potentially leading to lower returns. This competition can capture the risk associated with industry dynamics.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}
]}
